# Gate33 architecture delta

Gate32 is the immutable rollback. No new oscillator, audio callback, allocation or stock recording path is added.

- ControlState gains active_tracks (u32): 4404 → 4408 bytes. Submit and both verification passes skip excluded tracks; capture/read_all remains unchanged. A changed mask restarts an unfinished target pass; context and SDK compare-before-write checks remain mandatory. Excluded tracks retain their existing sound, including during bypass.
- GUI-only static page/bank fields consume 8 bytes; last-LFO-active consumes 1 byte. Identified state/static increase: 13 bytes before linker padding. Existing scratch banks and display allocation are unchanged. Native code/data allocation and CPU cost have not been measured.
- M2 reads page_key, uses signed encoder turns to set/clear bits, and coalesces any clicks in one tick into one bank switch. Click-plus-turn in one batch discards the turns so they cannot be assigned to the wrong bank. Page transitions clear queued events in the SDK and discard stale events at the controller boundary.
- Morph M2 explicitly returns from the stock shared-LFO tab to the registered machine display. Other machines' M2 behaviour is unchanged. Stock modifier chords still delegate before page interception, including BAR+M2 and BAR+M4.
- trackControl.sharedLfo is enabled. The existing SDK LFO supplies Input.values[11][3], already including stock modulation. A callback/context-gated helper reads the existing CV enable byte and tagged destination telemetry to distinguish active Morph modulation from unrelated destinations. No new stock address hook or audio work is introduced. Machine code uses the private access layer only.
- Autonomous LFO and recorded movement sample only at idle transaction boundaries. The immutable target runs to completion, including readback, so continuous updates cannot keep restarting at track 1. Manual movement keeps its existing event handling. This deliberately trades modulation update rate for bounded complete publication; fast LFO performance needs hardware assessment.
- LFO application never calls sdk_morph_movement_record. Manual AUX K4 still does. Only movement is followed, and neither LFO nor playback enables LIVE. When an observed LFO is disabled, the underlying stock movement value is sampled once after the current transaction. Stored destination publication/lock priority is unchanged.
- Save format version 2 retains the 5684-byte payload. Header word at offset 28 holds recorded-reference bit 0 plus routing mask in bits 8–15; other bits are rejected. Version 1 remains accepted with all tracks enabled. Existing snapshot/schema/checksum validation precedes publication. Stock retains LFO settings in its normal project data. No per-pattern snapshot bank map was added.

Tests execute the actual SDK/controller code with explicit stock-function, displayed-LFO and hardware-input doubles. They are not device waveform, audio timing or CPU measurements. Full SDK qualification remains incomplete; see CHECK_RESULTS.md.
